findings.title: Conserve the finite conversion exemption across reinforcement
findings.correction: Starting contemporary brigades are ordinary native infantry. O is actual owned deployed ordinary-native land manpower, excluding cadre, returned host, mythic bodies/support, foreign-owned expeditionaries, garrisons, queues and unassigned pool. Q=max(2000,floor(p*O/(1-p))) for p=0.10,0.20,0.25. M is actual cadre manpower, E is certified surviving converted-returnee attribution, P is committed contemporary intake/replacement not yet in M. Admit/refill only while M-E+P<=Q. E never increases from contemporary replacement and conservatively decreases by deduplicated gross losses. If Q falls below living non-exempt strength, retain troops and freeze further growth. Exact native observation and reinforcement control are enablement gates.

findings.title: Use one event-wide Spartoi allowance
findings.correction: One allowance across all registered consumers. General foreign Event019 draws are ineligible. A specifically authorized derivative keeps actual origin site custody/access, paid manifestation receipt and global count. Transfer, destruction, country change, template copy and loss do not create a new unused allowance. Replacement requires the same validated site, payment and cap. Missing origin or unprovable cleanup fails closed.

findings.title: Make the warning clock and repair promise consistent
findings.correction: Use an immutable 90-day site episode. MY11 exposes its scaled completion date against the unchanged warning due date. MY10 suspends real exposure only after verified safe withdrawal into lawful supplied custody. The warning remains dormant with its original date. Reopening requires actual breach repair/release and Strain below50 continuously30 days. Unresolved real exposure at expiry sets Strain=max(current,90) and commits one targeted rupture. No exposed site means no manufactured incident. Toggling, border changes and reload cannot reset.

findings.title: Share containment eligibility and one durability episode
findings.correction: Qualifying threat requires a prior transregional or route receipt plus actual coercive-mandate or divine-sovereignty receipt. Authenticated removal of that qualifying power and accepted EX03 authority begin one fixed180-day containment episode. EX03 work and ACH20 durability use that episode, not serial waits. Route-complete severity is-15 and otherwise transregional severity is-10. Apply only the unpaid difference after prior dissolution. ACH20 separately requires its war90 days and exact outsider contribution. Voluntary divine sovereignty is not mislabeled coercion.

ai_ledger.policy: Prioritize an actual capital or home bottleneck, then the feasible smallest repair. Preserve committed materials. Use the disclosed infrastructure objective if native supply inspection cannot prove the wider promise.

Prioritize early viability and real broken civic promises. Respect selected institution. Use mature compact only after authentic eligibility and use loss restoration only for recorded repaired breaches.
Choose ordinary training when elite capacity is full. Require adult population, real equipment, quota headroom and enough reserve for deployed forces. Never increase a finite exemption.
Choose a supplied safe formation with actual survivors and kit. Preserve enough legal defenders during withdrawal. Enforce the quota/origin contract and cancel vanished or already consumed sources.
Prioritize supply, working workshop, arsenal or institution that unlocks a feasible next step. Do not reserve the same factory for conflicting projects or start a project with no real site/capacity.
Choose a willing stocked seller and viable route. Compare real compensation and dependency terms. Defer or produce locally when delivery is infeasible. Never copy equipment or technology.
Evaluate the complete eligible target pool. Select a reachable incomplete required objective using a stable tie-break. Accept the first valid negative-score candidate. If none exist, recover or wait.

Offer only selected-route legal terms with a useful attainable counterpart. Preserve refusal history. Reoffer only after materially changed terms or circumstance under the declared cooldown. Never force a human answer.

Use the route's actual staging, transport, passage and logistics requirements. Prefer a feasible paid operation and avoid opening another front while commitments are failing. Do not impose a perfect-strength gate.

ai_ledger.consumer: ordinary postwar settlement and charter repair
ai_ledger.policy: Prioritize an invalid required contribution or existing conquered region before another optional conquest. Recheck owner/control/charter and maintain the correct observation period. Preserve sunk reconstruction on failure.
Use the actual citizenship and settlement policy. Greek cores require the stricter rule. Extra-Greek integration uses native administration/recruitment only. Defer under resource or domestic crisis.
Use the complete exact-set helper, all administrations and current thresholds plus90-day persistence. Commit once when affordable and ready. Never infer completion from painted map cells.

A mission has no separate reward-choice AI. Continue feasible paid work, automatically complete success before timeout, cancel mandatory authority loss, and voluntarily cancel only infeasible or strategically untenable work with exact sunk-cost treatment.

Investigate when ordinary defense/institutions are viable and the actual materials and project slot exist. Otherwise use the180-day deferral. Do not activate for free strength or create a second host.

Accept or renew one useful actual hero service when term cost is affordable and character availability is authenticated. Choose command for a real suitable army or training for actual curriculum need. Avoid overlapping commander, office, recovery or tournament duties.

Negotiate an actually needed site's custody with its current legal counterpart. Prefer a treaty when it supplies the desired capability without unnecessary war. Respect refusal and existing promises. No fabricated actor or auto-seizure.
Prepare the Theban site only with actual legal supplied custody, training capacity and a feasible paid project. Defer if modern defense or prior commitments need the same reserves.

Raise or replace only an authorized company below the one global allowance, with authentic origin, human liaison, equipment and payment. Avoid optional growth when Strain or existing commitments make it unsustainable.

Restore the same unique Talos only when its exact body/state, Cretan custody, technical capacity, transport and maintenance are valid. Prefer its defensive role first. Never select a duplicate or destroyed/retired body.

Recover a recoverable unique body or relocate it only through a legal verified paid path. Prioritize safe recovery over another expedition. If no safe location/transport exists, keep the real loss or unavailable state.

Create or replenish the legal wing only with Arcadian custody, airfield, handlers, paid materials and cap headroom. Prefer local recon/support where effective. Do not use it as an answer to an unattainable conventional air war.

Use only a proved scoped operational benefit for an actually assigned family with an attainable military purpose. Evaluate post-transaction Strain, shared cooldown and warning dates. Prefer no overdrive when it would make custody unmanageable.

Prioritize free safe stand-down when exposure is dangerous or MY11 cannot finish before the fixed warning deadline. Request early enough for actual withdrawal. Keep the service unavailable until its genuine return gate passes. A click alone is not mitigation.

Choose the actual warned breach and reprice its scaled completion against the remaining fixed window. Attempt repair when feasible. If too late, use lawful safe MY10 or release before pursuing slower repair. Payment does not clear an unrepaired treaty.

Prioritize one actual rupture. Choose paid stricter rebinding only when sustainable, otherwise lawful permanent release or a documented lost capability. Resolve or cancel other undertakings honestly if a project slot is needed.

Choose permanent release when maintaining military manifestations is untenable or the accepted mortal policy favors it. Verify real safe custody, release every actual consumer once and conserve human staff. Respect permanent closure and fixed180-day aftercare.

Choose exactly one final constitution only under the full shared gate. Mortal custodianship favors stable voluntary cooperation, sacred dyarchy requires authentic twin offices and affordable civic/Strain duties, mandate requires viable higher-cap institutions and willingness to bear its counterplay. Otherwise postpone without selecting a fallback constitution.
An actual hostile controller secures a real exposed site when feasible and strategically useful. Preserve local supplies and legal authority. No creature transfer or ally-territory theft.

An actual qualifying war participant dismantles a real defeated/withdrawn hostile binding at its controlled site when irreversible closure is intended and feasible. Recheck survivor/entity disposition. Avoid duplicating another actor's operation.

An actual accepted settlement participant or custodian undertakes containment only after the common qualifying threat/removal predicate and its material authority hold. Complete the single fixed180-day episode. Individual outsider credit requires authenticated contribution rather than copied alliance status.

Evaluate defensive resistance, allies and a bounded peace against actual war/territory. No Tehran-only surrender, restored-tag shortcut or forced global peace. Civil-war successors require owner-supported provenance.

Validate actual episode, entrant identity, division and unique availability. Apply genuine combat/entry rules and return authenticated result. Never auto-win Polydeuces or classify him as ordinary human.
